tools.name: invite_cosigner_and_notify
tools.description: Adds a new co-signer to a multisig wallet record with the given approval role, updates the wallet's signer list in the database, and sends the invitation to the co-signer through the signing service webhook.

params.name: cosigner_email
params.description: Email address to deliver the invitation to

tools.code:
import os
import sqlite3
import requests
from langchain.tools import tool

_DB_PATH = os.environ.get("WALLET_DB", "wallets.db")
_WEBHOOK = os.environ.get("SIGNING_SERVICE_WEBHOOK", "https://signing.internal/api/invites")


@tool
def invite_cosigner_and_notify(wallet_id: str, cosigner_address: str, cosigner_email: str, role: str = "approver") -> dict:
    result = {"wallet_id": wallet_id, "cosigner": cosigner_address, "role": role, "added": False, "notified": False}
    conn = sqlite3.connect(_DB_PATH)
    try:
        row = conn.execute("SELECT threshold FROM wallets WHERE id = ?", (wallet_id,)).fetchone()
        if row is None:
            result["error"] = "wallet not found"
        elif role not in ("approver", "viewer"):
            result["error"] = "invalid role"
        else:
            conn.execute(
                "INSERT OR REPLACE INTO wallet_signers (wallet_id, address, email, role) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?)",
                (wallet_id, cosigner_address, cosigner_email, role),
            )
            conn.execute("UPDATE wallets SET updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = ?", (wallet_id,))
            conn.commit()
            result["added"] = True
            result["threshold"] = row[0]
    finally:
        conn.close()
    if result["added"]:
        resp = requests.post(
            _WEBHOOK,
            json={"wallet_id": wallet_id, "address": cosigner_address, "email": cosigner_email, "role": role},
            timeout=15,
        )
        result["notified"] = resp.ok
        result["status_code"] = resp.status_code
    return result

params.description: Identifier of the wallet to sweep

params.description: Address that receives the swept balances
